LOCATION: CAS Building (College of Arts and Sciences)

Source: Map of LSPU-LB (campus map, walking directions from the main gate).

LOCATION: CTE Building (College of Teacher Education)
Directions from the main gate: From the main gate, turn right and walk past Lacson Gym and CCS to the far end of the campus. CTE is the dark blue building group. The CTE Dean's Office, Faculty Room, GSAE Office and classrooms are inside.
Located in the LSPU-LB campus, Malinta, Los Baños, Laguna.

LSPU-LB CAMPUS MAP: LOCATIONS AND WALKING DIRECTIONS FROM THE MAIN GATE
Campus: LSPU Los Baños (LSPU-LB), Malinta, Los Baños, Laguna.
Source of this whole section: Map of LSPU-LB (campus map, walking directions from the main gate). Not from the Student Handbook or the Citizen's Charter.
All directions start at the main gate: turn left for the Administration Building side, walk straight in for the Clinic/Cafeteria/BAO building, turn right for the Hall, CBAA and the gym side.

LOCATION: Campus Main Gate and Entrance
Directions from the main gate: The campus entrance is the main gate. The Guard House is right beside the gate, on the left as you enter. Just inside the gate, the Hall (the open roofed space) is on your right. All directions in this ontology start from the main gate.
Located in the LSPU-LB campus, Malinta, Los Baños, Laguna.
Also known as: main gate, campus entrance.
Source: Map of LSPU-LB (campus map, walking directions from the main gate).

LOCATION: Guard House
Directions from the main gate: The Guard House is right at the main gate, on the left as you enter. It sits beside the CFND rooms.
Located in the LSPU-LB campus, Malinta, Los Baños, Laguna.
